title: USDM: Fiat-Backed STABLECOIN - by Mehen: Cardano's Premiere Fiat-backed Stablecoin

ms.promise:
We have been working on the Mehen user app since before the Catalyst Fund 10 vote. Some things have changed since we submitted the Catalyst proposal. The Milestone outputs for Acceptance will not match up with the proposal's Milestone outputs for a number of reasons. 
A big change being that we need 6 Milestones for our project while our Catalyst proposal only had 4 Milestones. So, each of the Milestones submitted here will be different from our proposal for that obvious reason. Other changes between our Milestones here and the proposal Milestones are due to a shit in focus to deliver an MVP earlier than the Catalyst proposal called for, and a clarification as to which portions will be open-sourced.
Milestone 1 encompasses the design aspect of the Mehen user app. The following outputs will be produced:
・Concept of Operations (CONOPS)
・System Architecture Trade-Offs and Design
・Database Schema
・System Requirements Documentation
・Customer Service Documentation

(Portions of the operating documents, database schema, and other sensitive portions that can provide system vulnerabilities will not be submitted.)
ms.criteria:
Acceptance for Milestone 1 will be the delivery of the following products.
・Version 1 CONOPS
・Version 1 System Architecture Trade-offs and Design
・Version 1 Database schema
・Version 1 System Requirements Document
・Version 1 Customer Service Document
ms.report:
Milestone 1's requirements include "Version 1" of all the stated documents. We stated it this way because the regulatory landscape is NOT settled. Changes to laws and regulations could have significant impacts on our design considerations. Changes with our partners could also have significant impacts on us. What is being submitted today is update to date as of 2024-01-14.
We have also reserved the right to redact sensitive information from these documents that could put the Mehen App and our users at risk for fraud and/or abuse.
One reviewer felt that ChatGPT was used to create these documents. ChatGPT was not used. These documents are fairly standard documents and each has certain language that should be included in them. Some of the documents are meant to be written from a certain perspective (for example, a CONOPS is frequently written from the user's perspective). Some references and definitions are pulled directly from their sources. That may be what the reviewer is referring to, however, in those instances, links were provided either in the references and definition sections, or directly with the information quoted. An example would be defining what Amazon S3 is. Either way, links are provided in those cases and any reviewer can click on those links to see the sources.

CONOPS v1: https://mehen-catalyst-milestones.gitbook.io/concept-of-operations/ 
・The CONOPS Document is not a legal document.
・CONOPS stands for "Concept of Operations".
・The goal of the document is to outline the user's experience while using the Mehen App.
・A CONOPS document does not get into system implementation
・System implementation should be transparent to the user.
・For further information about a CONOPS document, please see: https://www.justice.gov/archive/jmd/irm/lifecycle/appendixc9.htm
・Some concerns about the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service were raised during the previous review.
・Links to the Plaid Privacy Policy and Plaid's Terms of Service will be included in the final versi

ms.promise:
Milestone 3 will focus on the integration between the traditional Banking industry and the Cardano network.
Web App
・Bank withdraws
・Add ADA deposit as part of connecting a Web3 wallet
・ADA is required for transferring USDM
・The additional signature/transaction handling helps verify that the user has the appropriate access to the connected wallet
・Hardware wallets cannot sign data yet, and therefore we will not be using that as a way to verify the user actually owns the wallet.
・Full Lambda function(s) to Mint and Burn USDM orders
・Will be an AWS Lambda function that runs once a day.
・Sum the Mint and Burn orders to decide if a Mint or Burn order is required.
・Submit the Mint or Burn order to the Cardano network
・Distribute the USDM/USD to each of the users who have a valid account and order.
・USDM Deposit and Withdraws
・Deposit through connected Web3 wallet
・Withdraws can go to any connected Web3 wallet for the user.

Server app
・Support the Web app functions listed above

Smart Contracts
・Fully integrate the Mint/Burn Smart Contract into a Lambda function
ms.criteria: Each of the above outputs should be able to be demo'd directly on the Cardano PreProd network via the deployed application.

ms.promise:
Final Deliverable will be the full Mainnet launch for the Mehen App. While the Mehen App is deployed on PreProd, we will be collecting user feedback. That feedback will generate internal Gitlab tickets for us to work off. Our focus will be more bug related as opposed to new functionality (although we will capture those too).
The ultimate output for this project will be the Mehen App being deployed to Mainnet and being connected to "Production" Plaid.
・Full KYC process with document and KYC check.
・KYC/AML monitoring.
・Auto-lock accounts and Mehen team notifications based on Plaid on-going monitoring.
・Bank and wallet transaction monitoring to update the App in near-real time.
・Successful Smart Contract Audit with any changes required to meet the audit requests (without sacrificing our Security and System Requirements)
・Final FAQ based on Feedback from PreProd users
・Full Customer Service plan to include reviewing KYC/AML issues via the Plaid Dashboard (The Mehen Admin app called out in the Catalyst project is no longer needed with the functionality we get from Plaid).
・Full Xerberus integration for Cardano Wallet monitoring

Production of our close-out report and video to IOG
ms.criteria:
Acceptance is based on us delivering the ability for users to successfully run through the KYC process, deposit/withdraw USD and USDM, and add mint/burn orders. The system should process those mint/burn orders and credit/debit each account accordingly.
This will all be able to be verified through the Mehen User App online.
Closeout video must be accepted by IOG.
